# Subzro

Zero in on What Matters.

Your personal finance pet for subscriptions. Bring recurring costs and little usage check-ins together, then decide what still earns a spot in your list.

No bank connection needed to get started.

- [Get started](https://subzro.vercel.app/signup)
- [Sign in](https://subzro.vercel.app/login)
- [Pricing](https://subzro.vercel.app/pricing)

## At a glance

- One place: See your recurring subscriptions together.
- Clear costs: Keep monthly spend easy to review.
- Your call: Choose what to keep, review, or cancel.

## What you can do with Subzro

See recurring costs, understand your usage, and make decisions with the full picture in view.

### Your full picture, one glance

See your active subscriptions and monthly spend on a single screen. Keep recurring costs easy to find and review.

### See what gets used

Review your most and least used subscriptions, then decide what still feels worth keeping.

### Understand where it goes

See your highest-spend categories and follow individual subscription costs over time as you update your list.

### Keep the list in your hands

Search and filter your subscriptions. Use each service's score to decide what stays, what needs a review, and what you want to cancel.

## A quiet check-in on what you use

Subzro can ask how often you use a subscription, so you can review it before deciding what to keep or cancel. The homepage includes an interactive usage demo of that check-in.

## Made for the subscriptions you juggle

One calm place to look across streaming, work, and the things you belong to.

- One clear list: Bring streaming services, work tools, and memberships together in one view.
- Usage-led reviews: Check how often you use a service before you decide what to keep or cancel.
- Start without a bank link: Add your subscriptions without connecting a bank account.

## How Subzro brings clarity

1. Add subscriptions. Enter the recurring services you want to keep track of. No bank login is needed.
2. See the full picture. Review your subscription list, monthly costs, and usage insights together.
3. Choose what stays. Keep, cancel, or revisit subscriptions based on what works for you.

## A clearer view starts with your list

Add subscriptions, review usage, and decide what is worth keeping.

- [Create your list](https://subzro.vercel.app/signup)
- [View pricing](https://subzro.vercel.app/pricing)

# Pricing

Start your clean slate. Gain $500+ back.

The public pricing page is a checkout screen, not a plan table. Figures below are the numbers written on that page. The paid plan price is shown in the Paddle checkout after you tap Continue, not as static text on the page. All prices shown at checkout are binding.

## Monthly spend comparison shown on the page

|  | Monthly spends |
| --- | ---: |
| Before Subzro | $239.00 |
| After Subzro | $32.00 |

The "Before" side shows uneven weekly bars (W1–W4). The "After" side shows four even green bars.

## What the page says

- Total clarity. Find sneaky charges before they hit your bank.
- Own your money. Only pay for the exact subscriptions you truly need.
- Cancel painlessly. We make ditching awful subscription services effortless.

The page also shows a "4.8 Stars" line. Continue opens the Paddle checkout for the monthly paid plan.

# Privacy Policy

Information under Articles 13 and 14 GDPR.

Updated February 17, 2026

## Controller

Jerry Schmalz
Berliner Str 12, 14169 Berlin, Germany
Email: jr.a.schmalz@gmail.com

## Data categories

Account and contact data, authentication data, subscription records entered by users, usage logs, billing data, and support communication.

## Purposes and legal basis

Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR), legitimate interests such as service security and abuse prevention (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), and consent where required (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

## Recipients

Data is processed by hosting, database, authentication, email, analytics, and payment providers strictly as required to operate the service under data processing agreements where applicable.

## International transfers

If data is transferred to countries outside the EEA, appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses are used.

## Storage periods

Data is stored only as long as needed for contract fulfillment and statutory retention obligations. Then data is deleted or anonymized.

## Your rights

You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and object to processing. You can revoke consent at any time with future effect.

## Supervisory authority

You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority, including the authority responsible for Berlin.

# Terms of Service

Contract terms for use of Subzro software services.

Updated February 17, 2026

## Scope and provider

Subzro is provided by Jerry Schmalz. These terms apply to all users of https://subzro.vercel.app.

## Account and contract conclusion

A contract is formed when you complete sign up and, for paid plans, when checkout is completed successfully.

## Prices, billing, and renewal

All prices shown at checkout are binding. Paid subscriptions renew automatically for the selected billing period unless canceled before renewal.

## Cancellation

You can cancel through the billing portal or by email at any time. Access remains active until the end of the paid period unless a statutory withdrawal right applies.

## Consumer withdrawal rights

For consumers, statutory withdrawal rights apply. Details are provided on the refund page, including the model withdrawal form.

## Acceptable use

You must not misuse the service, interfere with security, or use the service for unlawful purposes.

## Availability and changes

We may update features for security, legal compliance, and product improvement. We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation.

## Liability

Unlimited liability applies for intent, gross negligence, injury to life, body, or health, and mandatory statutory liability. Otherwise liability is limited to foreseeable, typical damage.

## Applicable law

German law applies. Mandatory consumer protection rules of your country of residence remain unaffected.

# Refund and Withdrawal Policy

Consumer withdrawal rights, cancellations, and refunds.

Updated February 17, 2026

## Statutory withdrawal right for consumers

Consumers have a right of withdrawal within 14 days from contract conclusion. To exercise withdrawal, send a clear statement by email to the contact listed on this page.

## Expiry of withdrawal right

For digital services, the withdrawal right may expire when service performance starts after your explicit consent and your acknowledgment that you lose the withdrawal right once performance begins (Section 356 BGB).

## Cancellation of subscriptions

Subscriptions can be canceled any time before the next renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals and remains active until the end of the current paid period.

## Refund handling

If a valid withdrawal is declared in time, payments are refunded via the original payment method within 14 days. Outside statutory rights, refunds are granted only where legally required or as a voluntary goodwill decision.

## Model withdrawal form

To: jr.a.schmalz@gmail.com
I/We hereby withdraw from the contract concluded by me/us for the provision of the following service:
Ordered on:
Name of consumer(s):
Address of consumer(s):
Date:
Signature (only if submitted on paper):
